description: nhflow_1d_si_nh_relax_implicit without B 95: the relaxation zones inside the step (A 505 1) take the reference step of their weights from the grid, 0.2 dx/sqrt(g h_max) (here 0.0044 s, close to the 0.004 s of nhflow_1d_si_nh_relax_implicit), so they relax per unit time as strongly as in the explicit step whatever the step (dt 0.05 s, gravity-wave Courant number 2.2).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::rz_auto (B 95 from the grid with A 505 1 and B 95 0)
